summary: Complete testing of Shamanic Elements Soul Temple 2.0 new batch features: Sound Frequencies (6 drum types), Creative Processes deep content (9 entries), Light Codes safety section, Practice Journal streak/share, Community sharing API, Videos API. All 25 backend tests pass (100%). All critical frontend flows verified.

issues: The 5 new drum entries (drums_gentle, drums_journey, drums_awakening, drums_fire, drums_return) have category='shamanic' in DB, but no 'Shamanic' filter tab exists in SoundFrequencies.jsx CATEGORIES array (only cetacean, instrument, frequency, nature are present). These 5 drum entries are ONLY visible in 'All Frequencies' mode. The classic Shamanic Drumming (freq-drum, category='instrument') does appear in the Instruments filter. Minor UX issue — users cannot specifically filter for 'Shamanic' drum journeys.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: Consider adding a 'Shamanic' category tab to SoundFrequencies.jsx CATEGORIES array (add { id: 'shamanic', label: 'Shamanic Drums', icon: Drum, ... }) so users can filter the 5 new drum journey entries. Currently they only appear in 'All Frequencies' view.
critical_code_review_comments: SoundFrequencies.jsx CATEGORIES array missing 'shamanic' tab — 5 new drum entries (category=shamanic) only visible in 'All Frequencies'. The 6th classic drum (category=instrument) shows in Instruments filter. This creates inconsistency in drum entry discovery.

PracticeJournal.jsx handleShareToCommunity(): checks `if (!api)` before sharing — but since api is an axios instance always provided, this check will never trigger. Consider checking for user authentication (user?.id or auth token) before allowing sharing.
seed_data_creation: None - all data already seeded in MongoDB. Verified: 17 sound frequencies (6 drums: 1 instrument + 5 shamanic), 9 creative processes (all with safety_precautions/why_this_heals), 15 videos across 8 categories.
